ads.author: Chad Ross
ads.title: Original 1987 Twin Cobra Arcade Cabinet (Project / Needs PCB Repair)
ads.description: Selling an original 1987 Twin Cobra arcade cabinet (Romstar/Toaplan). This is a complete, original cabinet that makes a perfect candidate for a dedicated restoration or a straightforward multicade/MAME conversion. The CRT monitor and power supply are working, but the original game board (PCB) currently needs logic-level repair to boot the game. The Details: Cabinet & Art: Solid cabinet with the original glass bezel and an original Romstar marquee in excellent, vibrant condition. The control panel overlay (CPO) shows typical arcade wear and peeling around the joysticks/buttons and will eventually need a reproduction sticker if you want a perfect look. Power Supply: The switching power supply is fully functional and recently dialed in. It is delivering a steady 5.12V to the board. CRT Monitor: The original CRT monitor is intact, receives power, and holds a raster/glow (no neck glow issues or broken glass). The Technical Issue (For Arcade Techs): The game board is currently stuck in a "watchdog reset loop." When powered on, the screen remains blank/gray and the audio outputs a continuous, rapid clicking/beeping sound. I have already cleaned the JAMMA edge connector, eliminated chip-creep by reseating all socketed ROMs, and verified the 5.12V line. The board is physically pristine with no gouges or visible corrosion, meaning a component (likely RAM or a logic chip) has failed internally. It will need to be diagnosed with a logic probe or sent to a mail-in repair specialist. Cabinet is sold as-is. It is heavy, so please bring a friend and a truck for loading. Ground floor pickup. Cash only.
